systems.country_label: Kinshasa revenue platform of the former DGRK

COD.note: The document is about Kinshasa's provincial revenue agencies and states nothing on an office connection.
Kinshasa is a city-province and its revenue agencies are upper tier; no basic-tier local government system stated.
Mentions the irms-dgrk platform and payment receipts for Kinshasa's provincial taxes but does not say tax payment is electronic or national.
